text: This landing filters unavailable and disallowed attachment entries before dispatching actions. copyUrl skips the file-availability filter, feed saves use an earlier separate path, and detach/delete retain their gate plus non-external filter. The new test checks saving the remaining filename, then cancels detach and delete prompts; those prompt checks do not prove completed mutation. No attachment, picker, native platform or test execution ran.
title: Attachment actions filter unavailable entries before operating on the remaining list
